Investment thesis

BMW i Ventures backs visionary early-stage founders tackling significant real-world problems in large markets, writing checks up to $10M. Its focus spans car development (autonomous, connected, electric, shared mobility, batteries, materials, sensors), digital sales and services, information technology (data analytics, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, dev tools), manufacturing (automation, additive manufacturing, IoT, cloud), supply chain (computer vision, data management, logistics optimization), and sustainability (decarbonization across energy, mobility, built environment, and industrials). Portfolio companies gain access to BMW's ecosystem through joint development, customer relationships, knowledge exchange, and technical validation.

Frequently asked questions

How many investments has BMW i Ventures made?
BMW i Ventures has 93 tracked investments, 9 of which have exited, including 9 dated in the last 24 months.
What stage does BMW i Ventures invest at?
BMW i Ventures invests at the Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A, Series B stages.
What is BMW i Ventures's typical check size?
BMW i Ventures typically writes checks of $10M.
What sectors does BMW i Ventures focus on?
BMW i Ventures focuses on Advanced Manufacturing, AI & Machine Learning, Cleantech, Climate Tech, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Data & Infrastructure, Developer Tools, Energy, Hardware, IoT, Logistics & Supply Chain, Mobility & Transportation, New Materials, Robotics, Semiconductors.
Where is BMW i Ventures located?
BMW i Ventures is headquartered in Mountain View, US.
Does BMW i Ventures lead rounds?
BMW i Ventures has led 12 of the 35 rounds where its role is on record.
Who does BMW i Ventures co-invest with?
BMW i Ventures most often shares deals with Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Y Combinator, Climate Investment, among 311 tracked co-investors.
What size deals does BMW i Ventures back?
Across 20 deals with disclosed amounts, BMW i Ventures has joined rounds of $450K – $200M (median $27M).
